List.flatMap_map.signature: theorem flatMap_map (f : α → β) (g : β → List γ) (l : List α) : (map f l).flatMap g = l.flatMap (fun a => g (f a))

List.map_eq_flatMap.signature: theorem map_eq_flatMap {f : α → β} {l : List α} : map f l = l.flatMap fun x => [f x]

List.map_flatMap.signature: theorem map_flatMap {f : β → γ} {g : α → List β} : ∀ {l : List α}, (l.flatMap g).map f = l.flatMap fun a => (g a).map f

List.flatMap_singleton.signature: theorem flatMap_singleton (f : α → List β) (x : α) : [x].flatMap f = f x

List.flatMap_cons.signature: theorem flatMap_cons {x : α} {xs : List α} {f : α → List β} : List.flatMap f (x :: xs) = f x ++ List.flatMap f xs
